_readme: THE config file for the Ladies of Destiny agent. pageId/pageName/igUserId/igUsername/pageAccessToken are AUTO-FILLED the first time a valid token is provided (paste a fresh Graph API Explorer token into data/meta-token.txt and push, or run the workflow once). To change posting time: edit 'slots' (EAT). To pause: set autoPost=false. IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (240 = the same 4-hour window Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali posts reliably with; past it that day's IG is skipped — the force button rescues it manually, posting just the IG half). Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (needs the DISPATCH_TOKEN repo secret).
